data.title: Case 2B: Multi-Agent Collaborative Grilling, Constraint Satisfaction & Temporal Planning (MACI)
data.description: Authoritative architectural reference for Multi-Agent Collaborative Intelligence (MACI), detailing how a higher-order Meta-Planner (MP), context-bounded 5W Node Agents, programmatic Edge Verifier Agents, Early Information Agents, and Clean-State Resets overcome the Gödelian Self-Reference Barrier and Stale Memory Propagation in Google Cloud ADK 2.0 and A2A temporal planning workflows.
